title.narrative: Berufliche und landwirtschaftliche Ausbildung von Jugendlichen zur Integration in den Arbeitsmarkt, Haiti
Vocational and agricultural training of young people for integration into the labour market, Haiti

description.narrative: Im Projektland herrscht eine sehr hohe Jugendarbeitslosigkeit, viele Jugendliche haben keine Perspektiven, eine Ausbildung zu durchlaufen, um in Zukunft ihr Leben finanziell autonom durch qualifizierte Handwerksarbeiten gestalten zu können. There is a very high level of youth unemployment in the project country, and many young people have no prospects of completing an apprenticeship in order to be able to organise their lives financially independently in the future through qualified manual work. Some young people turn to crime, others leave the country for lack of prospects or try to work as day labourers in the Dominican Republic. As part of the project, young people from precarious backgrounds are offered training opportunities in various trades. An important branch of training is sustainable agriculture.
